opportunities.title: Major Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Core costs: organisation’s annual income must be £1 million or over. Capital or project costs: total cost of project must be at least £1 million (organisation income not required).
opportunities.summary: Expression of interest for major grants of £1 million or more, covering core, capital or project costs.

opportunities.title: Regular Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Eligibility determined via the foundation’s eligibility quiz; grants are available for charities and organisations that meet the foundation’s criteria.
opportunities.summary: Open application for regular grants of up to £30,000 for local community capital projects and other funding needs, submitted through the Grants Portal.
